editorial.basis: Radiata had encompassed all animals with apparent radial symmetry, and other researchers were starting to remove Echinodermata and retain only Cnidaria and Ctenophora in Radiata.  Although it is not absolutely certain that Metschnikoff was intending to restrict (from its original definition) or emend (from its then-emerging definition) the existing taxon.
